quality_method.references: Frozen publisher references; not independently listen-checked. No natural long Meet recording provided.
quality_method.selection: Previously frozen first120 Svarah clips, unchanged between segmentation comparisons. Separate browser path uses first4 AMI and first10 Svarah clips, frozen before inference.
quality_method.cohort_policy: Indian English reported separately. Different paths/cohorts are not pooled into an aggregate pass. Near-threshold values are not rounded into a pass.
quality_method.segmentation: Real SFU Silero VAD and production SpeechSegmenter on assembled continuous PCM; Opus at24kbps also decoded before segmentation. Offline comparison has no WebRTC or Frappe queue. New policy flushes on first quiet frame after13s while retaining15s hard cap and all PCM bytes.

continuous_indian_english.interpretation: Same recognizer scores8.38% on original clip boundaries; segmentation contributes to the continuous-input loss. Pause-aware policy improves both conditions but broader cohort remains above10%.

longer_browser_path.path: Chromium microphone injection -> WebRTC/Opus -> SFU per-speaker VAD -> durable recorder -> actual shared GPU queue worker -> private Drive
longer_browser_path.critical_error_review: Names/numbers and timing require independent listening review; normalized WER alone is insufficient. Known speaker-channel identity is not mixed-audio diarization.

video_diagnosis.normal_stop_portable_ffmpeg8: Invalid final MPEG-TS segments reproduced. Retained logs show normal SIGTERM, not unexpected exit. Callback incorrectly mapped any segment error to ffmpeg_exited. Mapping corrected to capture_interrupted.
video_diagnosis.bookworm_ffmpeg5_1_9: Two native clean-stop checks passed with complete decodable audio/video; recorder image uses Bookworm. Browser combined followup still had one partial before matching-runtime retest; full container/browser validation remains required.
video_diagnosis.forced_process_loss: Native SIGKILL recovered a decodable partial with a marked gap; logs now preserve exit code and signal. No recording command changed to hide rejected segments.

bounded_load.note: Warm repeats over the same small dataset are a bounded inference soak, not independent quality evidence, full queue capacity, or a sizing/SLA result.

concurrent_captions.method: Eight fixed AMI clips, real-time paced WebSocket100ms chunks, isolated production-image replica alone and alongside batch inference. Actual production endpoint received no benchmark speech. Cold84s model startup excluded after readiness; initial pre-ready client setup failed.
concurrent_captions.limitation: Eight samples, one CPU-limited local replica and no adopted latency budget; insufficient for production coexistence acceptance.

production_safety.monitor_note: 30-minute guard stopped the isolated worker at its configured deadline; no production health or headroom stop occurred. Guard was bounded, not indefinite monitoring.
